paper_title: Laying the Foundation First Investigating the Generalization from   Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks
caption: Error analysis on Vanilla model (left) and HCL model (right).

annotations.annotation: The chart consists of two pie charts representing different categories of outcomes. The left pie chart displays four categories with the following labels and percentages: "Atomic Skill Fail" is represented by a dark teal color and accounts for 68.0%, "Correct" appears in a lighter teal color comprising 12.0%, "Reason Error" is shown in a pale teal and also represents 12.0%, while "Question Misunderstood" is depicted in white, making up 8.0% of the chart. The right pie chart also consists of four categories: "Correct" in light teal at 55.0%, "Reason Error" in pale teal at 21.0%, "Atomic Skill Fail" in dark teal at 10.0%, and "Question Misunderstood" in white at 14.0%. Both charts share a legend at the top for identification. The sections within both charts are labeled with their respective percentages, and the slices are ordered by size, descending within each chart. There are no exploded or visually emphasized slices.
